qe: At the 1921 census, what proportion of the population of the Patna district was living in urban areas?
qh: 1921 की जनगणना में पटना जिले की कुल जनसंख्या का कितना हिस्सा शहरी क्षेत्रों में रह रहा था?
e: Patna jile ki jansankhya ke adhyayan me yah baat saaf dikhti hai ki yahan shahari yaani urban abaadi ka hissa sadharan zilon se kaafi zyada tha. 1921 ki ganana ke samay jile me kul 2,18,895 log shahari kshetron me rahte the, jo jile ki kul abaadi ka lagbhag chaudah pratishat tha. Iski mukhya wajah yah thi ki jile me Patna shahar shamil tha, jisse shahri abaadi ka pratishat turant badh gaya. Shahri kshetron me chhah kasbe ganine me liye gaye - Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh; lekin Mokameh ke log zyadatar kheti ka kaam karte the tatha kasbe me isliye rahte the ki wahan ka khareef kshetra barish ke mausam me paani me dub jaata tha. Is tarah ek jile ke andar shahari tatha gramin jeevan ek saath dikhta hai. Exam point: 1921 ki ganana me Patna jile ki lagbhag chaudah pratishat abaadi shahri thi (2,18,895 log); iska mukhya karan jile me Patna shahar ka hona tha; shahri ganine me chhah kasbe the - Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh.

qe: Which of the six towns of the Patna district had mostly agriculturists living in it because the cultivated land around was submerged in the rainy season?
qh: पटना जिले के छह कस्बों में से किसमें रहने वाले लोग अधिकतर किसान थे, क्योंकि आसपास की खेती योग्य भूमि बरसात में पानी में डूब जाती थी?
e: Patna jile ke shahri kshetron me chhah kasbe ganine me liye gaye the - Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh. Inme Mokameh ek aisi jagah thi jahan rehne wale log zyadatar kheti ka kaam karte the, yaani woh kasbe ke rahne wale the magar kisan the. Iska saaf karan yah tha ki us ilake ki kheti ki zameen barish ke mausam me paani me doob jaati thi, isliye log mausam ke hisaab se kasbe me basa kar rahte the tatha kheti ka kaam chalate the. Baaki kasbon me Patna tatha Dinapore jaise sthal vyapar, prashasan tatha fauji chhawni ke liye jaane jaate the, isliye unki abaadi ka svarup alag tha. Aisi jaankari dikhati hai ki shahri-tatha-gramin ka bantwara keval abaadi ka sawal nahi, balki bhu-akar tatha nadi ke vyavhar ka parinaam tha. Exam point: Mokameh ke log zyadatar kisan the tatha kasbe me isliye rahte the kyunki aas-paas ki kheti ki zameen barish me paani me doob jaati thi; shahri ganine me shamil chhah kasbe = Patna, Bihar, Barh, Dinapore, Khagaul tatha Mokameh; Patna tatha Dinapore vyapar, prashasan tatha fauji chhawni ke kendra the.

qe: Which thana of the Patna district had the highest density of population at 1,562 persons to the square mile?
qh: पटना जिले के किस थाने में जनसंख्या का घनत्व सबसे अधिक, प्रति वर्ग मील 1,562 व्यक्ति था?
e: Patna jile me jansankhya ka ghanatv yaani density har jagah ek jaisa nahi thi. Ganga ke kinare base shahri tatha ardha-shahri kshetron me ghanatv sabse zyada tha; Dinapore thana me yah 1,562 vyakti per square mile tatha Phulwari thane me 1,036 vyakti per square mile tak pahunch gaya tha. Jile ka ausat ghanatv lagbhag 740 vyakti per square mile tha, lekin agar jile ke do bade shahron ko alag kar diya jaye, to ghanatv 700 se bhi kam ho jaata tha. Kheti wale thanon me ghanatv sabse kam tha - Mokameh me 506 tatha Masaurhi me 581 vyakti per square mile. Is tarah ghanatv ka naksha dikhata hai ki nadi ke kinare vyapar tatha prashasan ke kendra base the, jabki andar ke ilake kheti par nirbhar the. Exam point: Patna jile me sabse zyada ghanatv Dinapore thane (1,562 vyakti per square mile) tatha uske baad Phulwari (1,036) me tha; jile ka ausat ghanatv lagbhag 740 tha; kheti wale thanon me sabse kam ghanatv Mokameh (506) tatha Masaurhi (581) me tha.

qe: In the Patna district, which agricultural thana had the lowest population density at 506 persons to the square mile?
qh: पटना जिले में किस कृषि-थाने का जनसंख्या घनत्व सबसे कम, प्रति वर्ग मील 506 व्यक्ति था?
e: Patna jile me ghanatv yaani population density kheti tatha vyapar ke area ke hisaab se badalta tha. Ganga ke kinare base shahri kshetron me ghanatv bahut zyada tha, jaise Dinapore thane me 1,562 tatha Phulwari thane me 1,036 vyakti per square mile. Lekin jile ke kheti wale andaruni thanon me ghanatv kam tha; sabse kam ghanatv 506 vyakti per square mile Mokameh thane me tatha usse thoda zyada 581 vyakti per square mile Masaurhi thane me tha. Yah baat vishash hai ki kisi bhi thane ka ghanatv 500 se neeche nahi gaya, yaani poore jile me abaadi ka bantwara bahut had tak barabar tha. Isi kaaran kaha ja sakta hai ki shahri kshetra ghanatv badhaate the, jabki kheti wale kshetra ghanatv ko santulit rakhte the. Exam point: Mokameh thane me ghanatv sabse kam (506 vyakti per square mile) tatha Masaurhi me 581 tha; Dinapore (1,562) tatha Phulwari (1,036) me ghanatv sabse zyada tha; jile me kisi bhi thane ka ghanatv 500 se neeche nahi gaya.

qe: At the revenue survey in Patna each estate was treated as a village, and the number of nominal villages came to how many?
qh: पटना में राजस्व सर्वेक्षण के समय प्रत्येक एस्टेट (भू-संपत्ति) को ही गाँव मान लिया जाता था, जिससे नाम-मात्र के गाँवों की संख्या कितनी हो गई थी?
e: Patna jile me gaon ki ganana ka tareeka apne aap me ek mahatvapurn baat hai. Rajasv sarvekshan ke samay har estate yaani zameen ki har alag jagir ko hi ek gaon yaani mauza maan liya jaata tha; isliye jab estates kaafi bant gaye, to naam-matr ke gaonon ki sankhya bahut badh gayi tatha yah 4,952 tak pahunch gayi. Isse lagta tha ki jile me gaon bahut chhote tatha bahut adhik hain, lekin asliyat me yah keval ganana ka tareeka tha. Isi kaaran aage ek zyada tark-sangat ikai apnaya gaya tatha chhote estates ko unke mukhya gaon me shamil kar diya gaya, jisse gaonon ki sankhya ghat kar 2,596 reh gayi. Aisi jaankari dikhati hai ki sarkari aankdon ka matlab samajhne ke liye unke peeche ki ganana-paddhati ko jaan lena zaruri hota hai. Exam point: rajasv sarvekshan me har estate ko gaon (mauza) maana jaata tha, isliye naam-matr gaonon ki sankhya 4,952 ho gayi; ghanatv keval 500 se upar rehne ke kaaran jile me abaadi ka bantwara santulit tha; chhote estates ko mukhya gaon me shamil karne par gaonon ki sankhya ghat kar 2,596 ho gayi.

oe: Most villages were near the Ganges

Iska karan koi vibhinn vyavsayik ya bhu-akar nahi, balki yah tha ki jile ki seema me Patna shahar shamil tha; Patna kshetra ka bada vyaparik, shiksha tatha prashasanik kendra tha, isliye uski abaadi ko shahri ganine me liya gaya. 1921 ki ganana ke samay shahri kshetron ki abaadi 2,18,895 thi, jo jile ki kul abaadi ka lagbhag chaudah pratishat banta tha. qh: 1921 के आसपास पटना जिले में किन छह स्थानों को शहरी क्षेत्र माना गया था?
oe: Patna, Dinapore, Fatuha, Maner, Phulwari and Masaurhi
Patna, Bihar, Gaya, Barh, Masaurhi and Phulwari
